title: Scalable Co-Design via Linear Design Problems: Compositional Theory and Algorithms
summary: Designing complex engineered systems requires managing tightly coupled trade-offs between subsystem capabilities and resource requirements. Monotone co-design provides a compositional language for such problems, but its generality does not by itself reveal which problem classes admit exact and scalable computation. This paper isolates such a class by introducing Linear Design Problems (LDPs): design problems whose feasible functionality--resource relations are polyhedra over Euclidean posets.
